table.retrieve:
SELECT
	DocumentCode=MAX(ISNULL(DocumentCode,0)),
	Type=MAX(ISNULL(Type, '')),
	Date=MAX(ISNULL(Date, GETDATE())), 
	Remark,
	Name,
	Cash,
	AliasName, 
	Address,
	OpenBalance=MAX(OpenBalance),
	ClosingBalance=MAX(ClosingBalance),
	OtherDebit=MAX(OtherDebit),
	OtherCredit=MAX(OtherCredit),
	AreaCode,
	Area,
	CheckNo=NULL,
	VRow=NULL,
	VoucherCode=NULL,
	Header=NULL,
	Qty=SUM(Qty),
	Bonus=SUM(Bonus),
	Rate=Rate,
	GrossValue=SUM(GrossValue),
	Discount=SUM(Discount),
	ItemSaleTax=SUM(ItemSaleTax),
	ItemValue=SUM(ItemValue),
	NetRate,
	NetAmt=MAX(NetAmt),
	Debit=SUM(Debit),
	Credit=SUM(Credit),
	Others=SUM(Others),
	ReceivedOnInv=ISNULL(SUM(ReceivedOnInv), 0),
	PaidOnReturns= ISNULL(SUM(PaidOnReturns), 0)
FROM
	(SELECT  
		DocumentCode=S.SaleInvCode,
		Type='SV-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), S.SaleInvCode))),
		Date = S.Date, 
		Remark = (SELECT I.NAME FROM Item I WHERE I.ICODE = D.ICode),
		Name=c.Name,
		Cash = CASE S.SaleCatCode WHEN 2 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END,
		C.AliasName, 
		Address=C.Address1,
		OpenBalance=(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Debit-Credit), 0) FROM VirtualGL 
				WHERE	VirtualGL.AccCode=C.AccCode AND 
					VirtualGL.date < :ar_startdate),
		ClosingBalance=(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Debit-Credit), 0) FROM VirtualGL 
				WHERE	VirtualGL.AccCode=C.AccCode AND 
					VirtualGL.date < :ar_enddate),
		OtherDebit=(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(VirtualGL.Debit), 0) FROM VirtualGL 
				WHERE 
					VirtualGL.DocumentType NOT IN ('SV','SR') AND
					VirtualGL.AccCode=C.AccCode AND 
					VirtualGL.date BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate),
		OtherCredit=(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(VirtualGL.Credit), 0) FROM VirtualGL 
				WHERE 
					VirtualGL.DocumentType NOT IN ('SR','SV') AND
					VirtualGL.AccCode=C.AccCode AND 
					VirtualGL.date BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate),
		c.AreaCode,
		c.Area,
		CheckNo=NULL,
		VRow=MAX(D.RowID),
		VoucherCode=S.HeaderInvNo,
		Header=S.HeaderNo,
		Qty=SUM(D.LooseQty),
		Bonus=SUM(D.BonusQty),
		Rate=MAX(D.SalePrice),
		GrossValue=SUM(D.LooseQty * D.SalePrice),
		Discount=
			SUM(D.looseqty*D.itemflatdisc) +
			SUM(D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc) * (.01 * D.discperc)) + 
			SUM(D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc) * 
				(1-(.01*D.discperc)) * (.01 * S.discperc)),
		ItemSaleTax=SUM( (D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM((D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01),
		ItemValue=SUM(D.LooseQty * D.SalePrice) - 
			SUM((D.looseqty*D.itemflatdisc) +
					(D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc) * (.01 * D.discperc)) +
					(D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc) * (1-(.01*D.discperc)) * 
					(.01 * S.discperc))) + 
			SUM( (D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM((D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01),
		NetRate = (SUM(D.LooseQty * D.SalePrice) - 
			SUM((D.looseqty*D.itemflatdisc) +
					(D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc) * (.01 * D.discperc)) +
					(D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc) * (1-(.01*D.discperc)) * 
					(.01 * S.discperc))) + 
			SUM( (D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM((D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01)) / CASE WHEN SUM(D.LooseQty) IS NULL OR SUM(D.LooseQty)=0 THEN 1 ELSE SUM(D.LooseQty) END,
		NetAmt=T.NetAmt,
		Debit = CASE MAX(D.RowID) WHEN (SELECT MAX(SD.ROWID) 
			FROM SaleInvDetail SD 
			WHERE SD.SaleInvCode=S.SaleInvCode) THEN T.NetAmt ELSE 0 END,
		Credit= CASE MAX(D.RowID) WHEN (SELECT MAX(SD.ROWID) 
			FROM SaleInvDetail SD 
			WHERE SD.SaleInvCode=S.SaleInvCode) THEN CASE S.SaleCatCode WHEN 2 THEN 0 ELSE T.NetAmt END ELSE 0 END,
		Others= CASE MAX(D.RowID) WHEN (SELECT MAX(SD.ROWID) 
			FROM SaleInvDetail SD 
			WHERE SD.SaleInvCode=S.SaleInvCode) THEN ISNULL(S.MiscCharges, 0) - ISNULL(S.FlatDisc, 0) + ISNULL(T.InvSaleTax, 0) + ISNULL(T.RoundingDiff, 0) ELSE 0 END,
		ReceivedOnInv=ISNULL((SELECT SUM(SL.Amt) FROM SaleLedger SL WHERE SL.Posted = 'Y' AND SL.AccountFor = 'Y' AND SL.CustCode = C.AccCode AND SL.Amtdate BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate AND SL.Amt <> 0 AND SL.SaleCatcode = 2), 0),
		PaidOnReturns= ISNULL((SELECT SUM(R.Amt) FROM SRLedger R WHERE R.Posted = 'Y' AND R.AccountFor = 'Y' AND R.CustCode = C.AccCode AND R.Amtdate BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate AND R.Amt <> 0 AND R.SRCatCode = 7), 0)
	FROM
		(SELECT	A.AliasName, A.AccCode, A.Name, CT.Address1, CT.AreaCode, Area=AR.Name
		FROM	Accounts A, 
			(SELECT CT.* 	FROM Customer CT WHERE :ai_allcustomers = 1
			UNION ALL
			SELECT CT.* 	FROM Customer CT WHERE :ai_allcustomers = 0 AND CT.CustCode IN (:ai_custcode)) CT, 
			Area AR
		WHERE A.AccCode = CT.CustCode and AR.AreaCode=CT.AreaCode) C,
		SaleLedger S,	 
		SaleInvDetail D,
		(SELECT 
			SS.SaleInvCode, 
			RoundingDiff=
			ROUND(
			SUM( (DD.looseqty + DD.bonusqty) * DD.unitsalestax) + 
				SUM(ROUND( (DD.looseqty * 
					(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
					(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc)) * DD.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
				ROUND( (SUM((DD.looseqty * 
					(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
					(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) -
					SS.flatdisc) * (SS.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) + 
			Round(SUM((DD.looseqty*(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) + 
				SS.misccharges + SS.salestax - SS.flatdisc, 0) -
			(SUM( (DD.looseqty + DD.bonusqty) * DD.unitsalestax) + 
				SUM((DD.looseqty * 
					(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
					(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc)) * DD.gstperc * .01) +
				ROUND( (SUM((DD.looseqty * 
					(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
					(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) -
					SS.flatdisc) * (SS.invgstperc1 * .01), 2) + 
			SUM((DD.looseqty*(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) + 
				SS.misccharges + SS.salestax - SS.flatdisc),
			InvSaleTax=	ROUND((SUM((DD.looseqty * 
				(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) -
				SS.flatdisc) * (SS.invgstperc1 * .01), 2),
			NetAmt=ROUND(
			SUM( (DD.looseqty + DD.bonusqty) * DD.unitsalestax) + 
				SUM(ROUND( (DD.looseqty * 
					(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
					(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc)) * DD.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
				ROUND( (SUM((DD.looseqty * 
					(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
					(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) -
					SS.flatdisc) * (SS.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) + 
			Round(SUM((DD.looseqty*(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) + 
				SS.misccharges + SS.salestax - SS.flatdisc, 0)
		FROM SaleLedger SS, SaleInvDetail DD,
			(SELECT CT.* 	FROM Customer CT WHERE :ai_allcustomers = 1
			UNION ALL
			SELECT CT.* 	FROM Customer CT WHERE :ai_allcustomers = 0 AND CT.CustCode IN (:ai_custcode)) CT
		WHERE 
			SS.Posted = 'Y' AND SS.AccountFor = 'Y' AND
			SS.ImpactInventory='N' AND
			SS.SaleInvCode = DD.SaleInvCode AND
			SS.CustCode = CT.CustCode AND
			SS.date BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate
		GROUP BY
			SS.SaleInvCode,
			SS.DiscPerc,
			SS.FlatDisc,
			SS.InvGSTPerc1,
			SS.DiscPerc,
			SS.MiscCharges,
			SS.SalesTax) T
	WHERE   
		S.Posted = 'Y' AND S.AccountFor = 'Y' AND
		S.ImpactInventory='N' AND
		S.SaleInvCode = D.SaleInvCode AND S.SaleInvCode = T.SaleInvCode AND
		S.CustCode = C.AccCode AND
		S.date BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate
	GROUP BY 
		S.SaleInvCode,
		S.SaleCatCode,
		S.HeaderInvNo,
		S.HeaderNo,
		D.ICode,
		D.RowGroup,
		S.CustCode, 
		S.Date,
		S.DiscPerc,
		S.MiscCharges,
		S.SalesTax,
		S.FlatDisc,
		S.InvGstPerc1,
		C.AccCode,
		C.AliasName,
		C.Name,
		C.Address1,
		C.AreaCode,
		C.Area,
		T.InvSaleTax,
		T.NetAmt,
		T.RoundingDiff
	UNION ALL
	SELECT  
		DocumentCode=S.SaleInvCode,
		Type='SV-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), S.SaleInvCode))),
		Date = S.Date, 
		Remark = (SELECT I.NAME FROM Item I WHERE I.ICODE = D.ICode),
		Name=c.Name,
		Cash = CASE S.SaleCatCode WHEN 2 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END,
		C.AliasName,
		Address=C.Address1,
		OpenBalance=(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Debit-Credit), 0) FROM VirtualGL 
				WHERE	VirtualGL.AccCode=C.AccCode AND 
					VirtualGL.date < :ar_startdate),
		ClosingBalance=(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Debit-Credit), 0) FROM VirtualGL 
				WHERE	VirtualGL.AccCode=C.AccCode AND 
					VirtualGL.date < :ar_enddate),
		OtherDebit=(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(VirtualGL.Debit), 0) FROM VirtualGL 
				WHERE 
					VirtualGL.DocumentType NOT IN ('SV','SR') AND
					VirtualGL.AccCode=C.AccCode AND 
					VirtualGL.date BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate),
		OtherCredit=(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(VirtualGL.Credit), 0) FROM VirtualGL 
				WHERE 
					VirtualGL.DocumentType NOT IN ('SR','SV') AND
					VirtualGL.AccCode=C.AccCode AND 
					VirtualGL.date BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate),
		c.AreaCode,
		c.Area,
		CheckNo=NULL,
		VRow=MAX(D.RowID),
		VoucherCode=S.HeaderInvNo,
		Header=S.HeaderNo,
		Qty=SUM(D.LooseQty),
		Bonus=SUM(D.BonusQty),
		Rate=MAX(D.SalePrice),
		GrossValue=SUM(D.LooseQty * D.SalePrice),
		Discount=
			SUM(D.looseqty*D.itemflatdisc) +
			SUM(D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc) * (.01 * D.discperc)) + 
			SUM(D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc) * 
				(1-(.01*D.discperc)) * (.01 * S.discperc)),
		ItemSaleTax=SUM( (D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM((D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01),
		ItemValue=SUM(D.LooseQty * D.SalePrice) - 
			SUM((D.looseqty*D.itemflatdisc) +
					(D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc) * (.01 * D.discperc)) +
					(D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc) * (1-(.01*D.discperc)) * 
					(.01 * S.discperc))) + 
			SUM( (D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM((D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01),
		NetRate=(SUM(D.LooseQty * D.SalePrice) - 
			SUM((D.looseqty*D.itemflatdisc) +
					(D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc) * (.01 * D.discperc)) +
					(D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc) * (1-(.01*D.discperc)) * 
					(.01 * S.discperc))) + 
			SUM( (D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM((D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01)) / CASE WHEN SUM(D.LooseQty) IS NULL OR SUM(D.LooseQty) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE SUM(D.LooseQty) END,
		NetAmt=T.NetAmt,
		Debit = CASE MAX(D.RowID) WHEN (SELECT MAX(SD.ROWID) 
			FROM SaleDetail SD 
			WHERE SD.SaleInvCode=S.SaleInvCode) THEN T.NetAmt ELSE 0 END,
		Credit= CASE MAX(D.RowID) WHEN (SELECT MAX(SD.ROWID) 
			FROM SaleDetail SD 
			WHERE SD.SaleInvCode=S.SaleInvCode) THEN CASE S.SaleCatCode WHEN 2 THEN 0 ELSE T.NetAmt END ELSE 0 END,
		Others= CASE MAX(D.RowID) WHEN (SELECT MAX(SD.ROWID) 
			FROM SaleDetail SD 
			WHERE SD.SaleInvCode=S.SaleInvCode) THEN ISNULL(S.MiscCharges, 0) - ISNULL(S.FlatDisc, 0) + ISNULL(T.InvSaleTax, 0) + ISNULL(T.RoundingDiff, 0) ELSE 0 END,
		ReceivedOnInv=ISNULL((SELECT SUM(SL.Amt) FROM SaleLedger SL WHERE SL.Posted = 'Y' AND SL.AccountFor = 'Y' AND SL.CustCode = C.AccCode AND SL.Amtdate BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate AND SL.Amt <> 0 AND SL.SaleCatcode = 2), 0),
		PaidOnReturns= ISNULL((SELECT SUM(R.Amt) FROM SRLedger R WHERE R.Posted = 'Y' AND R.AccountFor = 'Y' AND R.CustCode = C.AccCode AND R.Amtdate BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate AND R.Amt <> 0 AND R.SRCatCode = 7), 0)
	FROM
		(SELECT	A.AliasName, A.AccCode, A.Name, CT.Address1, CT.AreaCode, Area=AR.Name
		FROM	Accounts A, 
			(SELECT CT.* 	FROM Customer CT WHERE :ai_allcustomers = 1
			UNION ALL
			SELECT CT.* 	FROM Customer CT WHERE :ai_allcustomers = 0 AND CT.CustCode IN (:ai_custcode)) CT, 
			Area AR
		WHERE
			A.AccCode = CT.CustCode and 
			AR.AreaCode=CT.AreaCode) C,
		SaleLedger S,	 
		SaleDetail D,
		(SELECT 
			SS.SaleInvCode, 
			RoundingDiff=
			ROUND(
			SUM( (DD.looseqty + DD.bonusqty) * DD.unitsalestax) + 
				SUM(ROUND( (DD.looseqty * 
					(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
					(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc)) * DD.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
				ROUND( (SUM((DD.looseqty * 
					(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
					(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) -
					SS.flatdisc) * (SS.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) + 
			Round(SUM((DD.looseqty*(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) + 
				SS.misccharges + SS.salestax - SS.flatdisc, 0) -
			(SUM( (DD.looseqty + DD.bonusqty) * DD.unitsalestax) + 
				SUM((DD.looseqty * 
					(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
					(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc)) * DD.gstperc * .01) +
				ROUND( (SUM((DD.looseqty * 
					(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
					(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) -
					SS.flatdisc) * (SS.invgstperc1 * .01), 2) + 
			SUM((DD.looseqty*(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) + 
				SS.misccharges + SS.salestax - SS.flatdisc),
			InvSaleTax=	ROUND((SUM((DD.looseqty * 
				(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) -
				SS.flatdisc) * (SS.invgstperc1 * .01), 2),
			NetAmt=ROUND(
			SUM( (DD.looseqty + DD.bonusqty) * DD.unitsalestax) + 
				SUM(ROUND( (DD.looseqty * 
					(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
					(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc)) * DD.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
				ROUND( (SUM((DD.looseqty * 
					(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
					(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) -
					SS.flatdisc) * (SS.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) + 
			Round(SUM((DD.looseqty*(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) + 
				SS.misccharges + SS.salestax - SS.flatdisc, 0)
		FROM SaleLedger SS, SaleDetail DD,
			(SELECT CT.* 	FROM Customer CT WHERE :ai_allcustomers = 1
			UNION ALL
			SELECT CT.* 	FROM Customer CT WHERE :ai_allcustomers = 0 AND CT.CustCode IN (:ai_custcode)) CT
		WHERE 
			SS.Posted = 'Y' AND SS.AccountFor = 'Y' AND
			SS.SaleInvCode = DD.SaleInvCode AND
			SS.CustCode = CT.CustCode AND
			SS.date BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate
		GROUP BY
			SS.SaleInvCode,
			SS.DiscPerc,
			SS.FlatDisc,
			SS.InvGSTPerc1,
			SS.DiscPerc,
			SS.MiscCharges,
			SS.SalesTax) T
	WHERE   
		S.Posted = 'Y' AND S.AccountFor = 'Y' AND
		S.SaleInvCode = D.SaleInvCode AND S.SaleInvCode = T.SaleInvCode AND
		S.CustCode = C.AccCode AND
		S.date BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate
	GROUP BY 
		S.SaleInvCode,
		S.SaleCatCode,
		S.HeaderInvNo,
		S.HeaderNo,
		D.ICode,
		D.RowGroup,
		S.CustCode, 
		S.Date,
		S.DiscPerc,
		S.MiscCharges,
		S.SalesTax,
		S.FlatDisc,
		S.InvGstPerc1,
		C.AccCode,
		C.AliasName,
		C.Name,
		C.Address1,
		C.AreaCode,
		C.Area,
		T.InvSaleTax,
		T.NetAmt,
		T.RoundingDiff
	UNION ALL
	SELECT  
		DocumentCode=S.SRInvCode,
		Type='SR-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), S.SRInvCode))),
		Date = S.Date, 
		Remark = (SELECT I.NAME FROM Item I WHERE I.ICODE = D.ICode),
		Name=c.Name,
		Cash = CASE S.SRCatCode WHEN 7 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END,
		C.AliasName,
		Address=C.Address1,
		OpenBalance=(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Debit-Credit), 0) FROM VirtualGL 
				WHERE	VirtualGL.AccCode=C.AccCode AND 
					VirtualGL.date < :ar_startdate),
		ClosingBalance=(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Debit-Credit), 0) FROM VirtualGL 
				WHERE	VirtualGL.AccCode=C.AccCode AND 
					VirtualGL.date < :ar_enddate),
		OtherDebit=(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(VirtualGL.Debit), 0) FROM VirtualGL 
				WHERE 
					VirtualGL.DocumentType NOT IN ('SV','SR') AND
					VirtualGL.AccCode=C.AccCode AND 
					VirtualGL.date BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate),
		OtherCredit=(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(VirtualGL.Credit), 0) FROM VirtualGL 
				WHERE 
					VirtualGL.DocumentType NOT IN ('SR','SV') AND
					VirtualGL.AccCode=C.AccCode AND 
					VirtualGL.date BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate),
		c.AreaCode,
		c.Area,
		CheckNo=NULL,
		VRow=MAX(D.SRUTN),
		VoucherCode=S.HeaderInvNo,
		Header=S.HeaderNo,
		Qty=-SUM(D.LooseQty),
		Bonus=-SUM(D.BonusQty),
		Rate=MAX(D.SRPrice),
		GrossValue=-SUM(D.LooseQty * D.SRPrice),
		Discount= -1 *
			(SUM(D.looseqty * D.SRPrice * (.01 * D.discperc)) + 
			SUM(D.looseqty * D.SRPrice * 
				(1-(.01*D.discperc)) * (.01 * S.discperc))),
		ItemSaleTax= -1 * (SUM( (D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM((D.looseqty * D.SRPrice) *
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01)),
		ItemValue= -1 * (SUM(D.LooseQty * D.SRPrice) - 
			SUM((D.looseqty * D.SRPrice * .01 * D.discperc) +
					(D.looseqty * D.SRPrice * (1-(.01*D.discperc)) * (.01 * S.discperc))) + 
			SUM( (D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM((D.looseqty * D.SRPrice * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01))),
		NetRate= ((((SUM(D.LooseQty * D.SRPrice) - 
			SUM((D.looseqty * D.SRPrice * .01 * D.discperc) +
					(D.looseqty * D.SRPrice * (1-(.01*D.discperc)) * (.01 * S.discperc))) + 
			SUM( (D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM((D.looseqty * D.SRPrice * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01))))) / CASE WHEN SUM(D.LooseQty) IS NULL OR SUM(D.LooseQty) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE SUM(D.LooseQty) END),
		NetAmt=T.NetAmt,
		Debit = CASE MAX(D.SRUTN) WHEN (SELECT MAX(SD.SRUTN) FROM SRDetail SD 
			WHERE SD.SRInvCode=S.SRInvCode) THEN CASE S.SRCatCode WHEN 7 THEN 0 ELSE T.NetAmt END ELSE 0 END,
		Credit= CASE MAX(D.SRUTN) WHEN (SELECT MAX(SD.SRUTN) FROM SRDetail SD WHERE SD.SRInvCode=S.SRInvCode) THEN T.NetAmt ELSE 0 END,
		Others= CASE MAX(D.SRUTN) WHEN (SELECT MAX(SD.SRUTN) 
			FROM SRDetail SD 
			WHERE SD.SRInvCode=S.SRInvCode) THEN ISNULL(S.MiscCharges, 0) - ISNULL(S.FlatDisc, 0) + ISNULL(T.InvSaleTax, 0) + ISNULL(T.RoundingDiff, 0) ELSE 0 END,
		ReceivedOnInv=ISNULL((SELECT SUM(SL.Amt) FROM SaleLedger SL WHERE SL.Posted = 'Y' AND SL.AccountFor = 'Y' AND SL.CustCode = C.AccCode AND SL.Amtdate BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate AND SL.Amt <> 0 AND SL.SaleCatcode = 2), 0),
		PaidOnReturns= ISNULL((SELECT SUM(R.Amt) FROM SRLedger R WHERE R.Posted = 'Y' AND R.AccountFor = 'Y' AND R.CustCode = C.AccCode AND R.Amtdate BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate AND R.Amt <> 0 AND R.SRCatCode = 7), 0)
	FROM
		(SELECT	A.AliasName, A.AccCode, A.Name, CT.Address1, CT.AreaCode, Area=AR.Name
		FROM	Accounts A, 
			(SELECT CT.* 	FROM Customer CT WHERE :ai_allcustomers = 1
			UNION ALL
			SELECT CT.* 	FROM Customer CT WHERE :ai_allcustomers = 0 AND CT.CustCode IN (:ai_custcode)) CT, 
			Area AR
		WHERE
			A.AccCode = CT.CustCode and 
			AR.AreaCode=CT.AreaCode) C,
		SRLedger S,	 
		SRDetail D,
		(SELECT 
			SS.SRInvCode, 
			RoundingDiff=
			ROUND(
			SUM( (DD.looseqty + DD.bonusqty) * DD.unitsalestax) + 
				SUM(ROUND( (DD.looseqty * DD.SRPrice) *
					(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc)) * DD.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
				ROUND( (SUM((DD.looseqty * DD.SRPrice) *
					(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) -
					SS.flatdisc) * (SS.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) + 
			Round(SUM((DD.looseqty * DD.SRPrice) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) + 
				SS.misccharges + SS.salestax - SS.flatdisc, 0) -
			(SUM( (DD.looseqty + DD.bonusqty) * DD.unitsalestax) + 
				SUM((DD.looseqty * DD.SRPrice) *
		
					(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc)) * DD.gstperc * .01) +
				ROUND( (SUM((DD.looseqty * DD.SRPrice) *
					(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) -
					SS.flatdisc) * (SS.invgstperc1 * .01), 2) + 
			SUM((DD.looseqty * DD.SRPrice *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) + 
				SS.misccharges + SS.salestax - SS.flatdisc)),
			InvSaleTax=	ROUND((SUM((DD.looseqty * DD.SRPrice) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) -
				SS.flatdisc) * (SS.invgstperc1 * .01), 2),
			NetAmt=ROUND(
			SUM( (DD.looseqty + DD.bonusqty) * DD.unitsalestax) + 
				SUM(ROUND( (DD.looseqty * DD.SRPrice) *
					(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc)) * DD.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
				ROUND( (SUM((DD.looseqty * DD.SRPrice) *
					(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) -
					SS.flatdisc) * (SS.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) + 
			Round(SUM((DD.looseqty * DD.SRPrice) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) + 
				SS.misccharges + SS.salestax - SS.flatdisc, 0)
		FROM SRLedger SS, SRDetail DD,
			(SELECT CT.* 	FROM Customer CT WHERE :ai_allcustomers = 1
			UNION ALL
			SELECT CT.* 	FROM Customer CT WHERE :ai_allcustomers = 0 AND CT.CustCode IN (:ai_custcode)) CT
		WHERE 
			SS.Posted = 'Y' AND SS.AccountFor = 'Y' AND
			SS.CustCode = CT.CustCode AND
			SS.SRInvCode = DD.SRInvCode AND
			SS.date BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate
		GROUP BY
			SS.SRInvCode,
			SS.DiscPerc,
			SS.FlatDisc,
			SS.InvGSTPerc1,
			SS.DiscPerc,
			SS.MiscCharges,
			SS.SalesTax) T
	WHERE   
		S.Posted = 'Y' AND S.AccountFor = 'Y' AND
		S.SRInvCode = D.SRInvCode AND S.SRInvCode = T.SRInvCode AND
		S.CustCode = C.AccCode AND
		S.date BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate
	GROUP BY 
		S.SRInvCode,
		S.SRCatCode,
		S.HeaderInvNo,
		S.HeaderNo,
		D.ICode,
		S.CustCode, 
		S.Date,
		S.DiscPerc,
		S.MiscCharges,
		S.SalesTax,
		S.FlatDisc,
		S.InvGstPerc1,
		C.AccCode,
		C.AliasName,
		C.Name,
		C.Address1,
		C.AreaCode,
		C.Area,
		T.InvSaleTax,
		T.NetAmt,
		T.RoundingDiff) T
GROUP BY
	Name,
	Cash,
	AliasName, 
	Address,
	AreaCode,
	Area,
	Remark,
	Rate,
	NetRate
UNION ALL
SELECT
	V.DocumentCode, 
	Type = V.DocumentType + '-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), V.DocumentCode))), 
	Date = V.Date, 
	Remark = CASE debit 
			WHEN 0 THEN 'Cash Paid Against Sale Ret. # '
			ELSE 'Cash Received Against Sales Inv. # '
			END + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(6), V.DocumentCode))),
	c.Name,
	Cash = CASE ISNULL(v.AlternateAccCode, -1) WHEN -1 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END,
	C.AliasName,
	Address=c.Address1,
	OpenBalance=(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Debit-Credit), 0) FROM VirtualGL 
			WHERE	Virtualgl.AccCode=C.AccCode and 
				VirtualGL.Date < :ar_startdate),
	ClosingBalance=(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Debit-Credit), 0) FROM VirtualGL 
			WHERE	VirtualGL.AccCode=C.AccCode AND 
				VirtualGL.date < :ar_enddate),
	OtherDebit=(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(VirtualGL.Debit), 0) FROM VirtualGL 
			WHERE 
				VirtualGL.DocumentType NOT IN ('SV','SR') AND
				VirtualGL.AccCode=C.AccCode AND 
				VirtualGL.date BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate),
	OtherCredit=(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(VirtualGL.Credit), 0) FROM VirtualGL 
			WHERE 
				VirtualGL.DocumentType NOT IN ('SR','SV') AND
				VirtualGL.AccCode=C.AccCode AND 
				VirtualGL.date BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate),
	C.AreaCode,
	c.Area,
	V.CheckNo,
	V.VRow,
	V.vouchercode,
	Header=NULL,
	Qty=0,
	Bonus=0,
	Rate=0,
	GrossValue=0,
	Discount=0,
	ItemSaleTax=0,
	ItemValue=0,
	NetRate = 0,
	NetAmt=0,
	Debit = V.Credit,
	Credit= V.Debit,
	Others=0,
	ReceivedOnInv=ISNULL((SELECT SUM(SL.Amt) FROM SaleLedger SL WHERE SL.Posted = 'Y' AND SL.AccountFor = 'Y' AND SL.CustCode = C.AccCode AND SL.Amtdate BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate AND SL.Amt <> 0 AND SL.SaleCatcode = 2), 0),
	PaidOnReturns= ISNULL((SELECT SUM(R.Amt) FROM SRLedger R WHERE R.Posted = 'Y' AND R.AccountFor = 'Y' AND R.CustCode = C.AccCode AND R.Amtdate BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate AND R.Amt <> 0 AND R.SRCatCode = 7), 0)
FROM 
	VirtualGL V,
	(SELECT	A.AliasName, A.AccCode, A.Name, CT.Address1, CT.AreaCode, Area=AR.Name
	FROM	Accounts A, 
		(SELECT CT.* 	FROM Customer CT WHERE :ai_allcustomers = 1
		UNION ALL
		SELECT CT.* 	FROM Customer CT WHERE :ai_allcustomers = 0 AND CT.CustCode IN (:ai_custcode)) CT, 
		Area AR
	WHERE	
		A.AccCode = CT.CustCode and 
		AR.AreaCode=CT.AreaCode) C
WHERE   
	V.DocumentType NOT IN ('SV', 'SR') AND
	(V.AlternateAccCode = C.AccCode ) and
	V.date     >= :ar_startdate and
	V.date     <= :ar_enddate
UNION ALL
SELECT
	DocumentCode=NULL, 
	Type = NULL, 
	Date = NULL, 
	Remark = NULL,
	c.Name,
	Cash = NULL,
	C.AliasName,
	Address=c.Address1,
	OpenBalance=(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Debit-Credit), 0) FROM VirtualGL 
			WHERE	Virtualgl.AccCode=C.AccCode and 
				VirtualGL.Date < :ar_startdate),
	ClosingBalance=(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Debit-Credit), 0) FROM VirtualGL 
			WHERE	VirtualGL.AccCode=C.AccCode AND 
				VirtualGL.date < :ar_enddate),
	OtherDebit=(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(VirtualGL.Debit), 0) FROM VirtualGL 
			WHERE 
				VirtualGL.DocumentType NOT IN ('SV','SR') AND
				VirtualGL.AccCode=C.AccCode AND 
				VirtualGL.date BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate),
	OtherCredit=(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(VirtualGL.Credit), 0) FROM VirtualGL 
			WHERE 
				VirtualGL.DocumentType NOT IN ('SR','SV') AND
				VirtualGL.AccCode=C.AccCode AND 
				VirtualGL.date BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate),
	C.AreaCode,
	c.Area,
	CheckNo=NULL,
	VRow=NULL,
	vouchercode=NULL,
	Header=NULL,
	Qty=0,
	Bonus=0,
	Rate=0,
	GrossValue=0,
	Discount=0,
	ItemSaleTax=0,
	ItemValue=0,
	NetRate = 0,
	NetAmt=0,
	Debit = 0,
	Credit= 0,
	Others=0,
	ReceivedOnInv=ISNULL((SELECT SUM(SL.Amt) FROM SaleLedger SL WHERE SL.Posted = 'Y' AND SL.AccountFor = 'Y' AND SL.CustCode = C.AccCode AND SL.Amtdate BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate AND SL.Amt <> 0 AND SL.SaleCatcode = 2), 0),
	PaidOnReturns= ISNULL((SELECT SUM(R.Amt) FROM SRLedger R WHERE R.Posted = 'Y' AND R.AccountFor = 'Y' AND R.CustCode = C.AccCode AND R.Amtdate BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate AND R.Amt <> 0 AND R.SRCatCode = 7), 0)
FROM 
	(SELECT	A.AliasName, A.AccCode, A.Name, CT.Address1, CT.AreaCode, Area=AR.Name
	FROM	Accounts A, 
		(SELECT CT.* 	FROM Customer CT WHERE :ai_allcustomers = 1
		UNION ALL
		SELECT CT.* 	FROM Customer CT WHERE :ai_allcustomers = 0 AND CT.CustCode IN (:ai_custcode)) CT, 
		Area AR
	WHERE	
		A.AccCode NOT IN 
			(SELECT DISTINCT SL.CustCode FROM SaleLedger SL WHERE SL.Date BETWEEN :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate 
			UNION 
			SELECT DISTINCT SL.CustCode FROM SRLedger SL WHERE SL.Date BETWEEN :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate ) AND
		A.AccCode = CT.CustCode and 
		AR.AreaCode=CT.AreaCode) C
ORDER BY
	Name, 
	AliasName, 
	VRow

objects.name: compute_2
objects.expression: IF(openbalance + cumulativeSum(  debit  -  credit  for group 1 ) +  otherdebit - othercredit - receivedoninv + paidonreturns > 0, '', IF(openbalance + cumulativeSum(  debit  -  credit  for group 1 ) +  otherdebit - othercredit - receivedoninv + paidonreturns < 0, 'Cr', ''))
